Third millennium.''"
"''It's a good guess.''"
"''The stone is Carvian, but it's older, isn't it?''"
"''We think it's Lost Empire.|Strang and Luthen Rael discuss Luthen's ring|audio=Strang-Luthen-WhatAFestiveEvening.flac|}} '''Strang''' was an [[Strang's species|alien]] [[antiques dealer]] who attended a [[Senate Investiture]] [[Standard week|week]] [[Davo Sculdun's party|party]] hosted by the antiquities [[collector]] [[Davo Sculdun]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in [[3 BBY]]. Strang tried to guess the age of fellow dealer [[Luthen Rael]]'s [[Luthen's ring|ring]] at the event before joining a tour of Sculdun's [[Davo Sculdun's gallery|gallery of antiquities]]. During the tour, Sculdun showed Strang and the others a number of artifacts, including the [[Lost Tairn]] and the [[Tinian Codex]], and a tense debate occured between [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] and [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]]. ==Biography== ===Ring analysis=== {{Quote|My word, Luthen. And you wear it out?''"
"''I thought one of you thieves might make me an offer.''"
"''It takes one to know one, Luthen.|Cleave and Luthen Rael discuss Luthen's ring|audio=Cleave-Luthen-WhatAFestiveEvening.flac|}} [[File:AntiquesDealers-WhatAFestiveEvening.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Strang, Cleave, and another well-dressed human stand around a brightly lit table in Sculdun Tower as Luthen Rael shows off a ring during a party.|Strang tried to guess the age of Luthen Rael's ring.]] Strang was an [[Strang's species|alien]] [[antiques dealer]]{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} {{AD|Disney+}} who attended an [[Davo Sculdun's party|Investiture Party]] hosted by the antiquities [[collector]] [[Davo Sculdun]] in [[Sculdun Tower]] on the [[planet]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[Coruscant]] during [[Senate Investiture]] [[Standard week|week]] in [[3 BBY]].{{AndorDate|206}} At the party, Strang examined a [[Luthen's ring|ring]] worn by fellow antiques dealer [[Luthen Rael]]—secretly a member of the rebel [[Axis network]]—and guessed that it was pre-[[Carvian]] from the [[third millennium]], but Rael dismissed this as a good guess. Strang then acknowledged that the [[stone]] was Carvian, but reasserted that the ring was older. Rael then revealed that it was thought to date to the [[Lost Empire]], shocking the antiques dealer [[Cleave]], who was surprised Rael wore out such an ancient piece. Rael then told the other dealers that he had brought it in the hope that one of them might make an offer to purchase it, earning a laugh when he called them all [[Thief|thieves]]. ===A tense tour=== {{Quote|It's a book. You read by touch, your hand. It's from a planet where blindness was considered a gift.''"
"''Oh, well, I'm sure we can all think of some people who would be right at home.|Lonni Jung and Orson Krennic discuss the Tinian Codex|audio=Jung-Krennic-TinianCodex-WhatAFestiveEvening.flac|}} [[File:StrangTour-WhatAFestiveEvening.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Mishko, Strang, Cleave, Krennic, and Lagret stand around the Lost Tairn in Sculdun Tower as Davo Sculdun leans closely over the artifact.|Strang took part in a tour of Davo Sculdun's antiques gallery.]] Rael, Strang, and Cleave were among those chosen for a tour of Sculdun's [[Davo Sculdun's gallery|gallery of antiquities]] along with [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] and her [[Marriage|husband]], [[Perrin Fertha]], who motioned Strang and Cleave and the gallery's art consultant, [[Mishko]], over as the tour was about to begin. Cleave responded that the trio would meet the others there. The [[Imperial Security Bureau]] personnel [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]], [[Avril Heert]], [[Lagret]], and [[Moy]] also joined the tour, as did Sculdun's [[Gender|wife]],{{Databank|runai-sculdun|Runai Sculdun}} [[Runai Sculdun]]. Davo started the tour with introductions and then showed the group the [[Lost Tairn]] artifact as Rael's [[Aide|assistant]], [[Kleya Marki]], entered the gallery separately with bureau member [[Lonni Jung]] to remove a [[listening device]] from the [[Tinian Codex]] artifact. Once Sculdun had finished describing the tairn, the group moved on to other objects in the gallery including a [[Carmeenian helmet]], which prompted an intense debate between Mothma and Krennic on the nature of the [[Battle of Carmeen]]. Strang and Cleave stood together listening to the debate, each holding a drink [[glass]]. [[File:StrangLaughing-WhatAFestiveEvening.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Expressions of mirth on their faces, Strang, Mishko, Luthen Rael, Lonni Jung, and Cleave stand around the Tinian Codex in Davo Sculdan's stark white antiques gallery.|Strang laughed at Orson Krennic's joke.]] Davo eventually moved the group on to an object that had been found being used as ballast in a [[swamp]] [[freighter]], eliciting a laugh from them all. They then reached Jung and Marki, who had just removed the device, at the codex, and Jung explained that the artifact was from a [[Unidentified Tinian planet|world]] where blindness was considered a gift. When Krennic quipped that they all knew people who would be right at home on such a world, Strang and others laughed. ==Personality and traits== Strang had thick hands with stubby fingers, [[Color|white]] skin, white [[hair]], and gray [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== At Sculdun's party, Strang wore black, white, and gray [[robe]]s with a golden [[bracelet]] on their right [[Limb|wrist]] and a silver brooch with an amber-colored brooch at their throat. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:StrangConcept-IvanManzella.jpg|thumb|right|350px|alt=Concept art of Strang shows the character in a high-collared black shirt with a white patterened shawl over it.|Ivan Manzella created concept art of Strang.]] Strang appeared in "[[What a Festive Evening]]," the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']]{{'s}} [[Andor Season 2|second season]], which premiered on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} [[Ivan Manzella]] created concept art of Strang.{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}} The character's suit was produced by the CFX team and worn by [[Aidan Cook]], while [[Claire Roi Harvey]] provided Strang's voice. The role was Harvey's first voice credit on a ''[[Star Wars]]'' project, and she also performed the lip sync and on-set dialogue, with [[Mike Quinn]] and [[Jessie Hinton]] controlling the character's eyes with support from the CFX Coordinator [[Derek Arnold]]. Some of Strang's scenes were filmed inside a [[Wikipedia:Faraday cage|Faraday cage]], which caused issues with transmitters.{{Instagram|username=claireroiharvey|url=p/DJ2aYcYoPvz|name=[[Claire Roi Harvey]]|date=2025-05-19|quote=Andor season 2- This is 'Strang' seen at Davo Sculduns party & art exhibition. I was very fortunate to perform across a number of epic teams and characters on this season, but this one is a bit special, because not only did I perform the lip sync and live on set dialogue- I got my first Star Wars voice credit. Go listen to my very best space antiques enthusiast voice in the episode 'what a festive evening’. This character was created by the brilliant CFX team with insanely good animatronic design by @gustavhoegan. Suit performance by #aidancook , performing the eyes @mikequinnstudios & my sis the wonderful #jessiehinton all supported by CFX Coordinator @itsaderek 💪🏼 💪🏼 That whole scene is populated by so many EPIC suit performers and hidden puppeteers and CFX crew all working at the top of their game- it really takes a (space) village #starwarscreatures #andor #andorseason2 #animatronics #puppetry #practicaleffects #starwarsanimatronics Fun fact: when you’re shooting in a faraday cage, your transmitters might decide to do their own thing 🤪|archiveurl=https://archive.is/iC2fU|archivefile=File:ClaireRoiHarvey-Strang-Instagram.png}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Strang|imagecat=Images of Strang}} *{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=ストラング |ka=სტრენგი }} [[Category:Antiques dealers]] [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
